questions.question: In agreement with the information outlined in the income statement, what is the FY2015 - FY2017 3 year average net profit margin (as a %) for Best Buy? Answer in units of percents and round to one decimal place.

answer.answer: Best Buy's average net profit margin over fiscal 2015 to fiscal 2017 was 2.8%, based on margins of 3.1%, 2.3% and 3.1%. Computed: net profit margin FY2015 = 1,235 / 40,339 x 100 = 3.1%; net profit margin FY2016 = 897 / 39,528 x 100 = 2.3%; net profit margin FY2017 = 1,228 / 39,403 x 100 = 3.1%; 3-year average net profit margin FY2015-FY2017 = 8.45 / 3 = 2.8%. Source: Best Buy 10-K (period ended 28 Jan 2017).
